# ORÉVA Jewellery House

> Elegance, Made Eternal.

## Brand Overview
ORÉVA is a contemporary luxury jewellery house built around elegance, individuality, and timeless design. The house presents curated jewellery collections—including necklaces, earrings, bracelets, rings, enamel bangles, and hair accessories—through sophisticated visual storytelling.

## Showcase & Enquiry Model
ORÉVA operates as a high-end digital showcase where clients discover exquisite collections and connect directly with our jewellery concierges via tailored WhatsApp enquiries.

## Architecture
- Framework: Next.js (App Router, Server Components default) + React 19
- Styling: Tailwind CSS v4, Base UI, Shadcn UI
- Typography: Cormorant Garamond & Manrope
- Database: MongoDB Native Driver
- Authentication: Better Auth
- Motion & Animation: GSAP & modern transitions
